name: altium-copilot-kc
description: AI copilot for Altium Designer (Windows only). Reads live schematics from a running Altium instance — trace nets, inspect components, switch variants, and run structured design reviews, all from Claude. Requires Altium Designer installed and running on Windows.

tools.name: detect_altium_project
tools.description: Detect whether Altium Designer is running, which project is currently open, and list previously loaded projects from the local registry. Always call this first to orient Claude before loading a project.

tools.name: get_clone_status
tools.description: Show where the project's local copy stands against Altium 365, read offline from its Git clone: project GUID, last fetch time, commits ahead or behind as of that fetch, uncommitted local changes and the last commit, with a warning when the last fetch is old. Never fetches.

tools.name: set_project_dir
tools.description: Load an Altium project from disk given its folder path. Parses the .PrjPcb file, reads all schematic sheets, and generates a Protel netlist by automating Altium's export. Required before calling any other tool. Altium Designer must have the project open when the netlist has to be generated; with Altium closed and no up-to-date netlist, the netlist is compiled offline from the saved sheets and every tool works (only when no sheet can be compiled does the project load partially, without a netlist).

tools.name: refresh_netlist
tools.description: Regenerate the netlist after the user saves schematic changes in Altium (or compile it again offline when Altium is closed). Only call when the user confirms they have saved — do not call speculatively.

tools.name: query_net
tools.description: Find nets by name and return every component pin connected to them. Accepts a case-insensitive regex for discovery (e.g. 'UART' finds all UART nets, 'GND' finds GND/AGND/DGND). If the pattern contains regex metacharacters and is invalid (e.g. +5V, +3V3, VIN[0]), falls back to exact case-insensitive match automatically. High-fanout nets like power rails are flagged and sampled. Use this to discover net names or trace a specific net across sheets.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Get full detail for a component by reference designator (e.g. U1, R14). Returns the MPN, value, DNP status, and every pin with its connected net.

tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Search components using a regex pattern against refdes, MPN, or description. Results are grouped by MPN with per-group counts — useful for finding all instances of a part or all components matching a description.

tools.name: get_sheet_context
tools.description: Get all components on a schematic sheet with their pin-to-net connections and cross-sheet neighbors, plus the designer's notes on that sheet. Results are paginated — if has_more:true, use the offset from the next: line to call again. Pass a sheet name or omit to use the currently active sheet in Altium.

tools.name: get_design_notes
tools.description: Read the information designers added besides the circuit: project parameters, schematic notes, text frames, labels, pictures, directives and title blocks, and Draftsman fabrication/assembly notes, tables, view titles, drill table and layer stack notes. Paginated; pass a sheet or Draftsman document name to read one document.

tools.name: get_design_hierarchy
tools.description: Offline Report Project Hierarchy: the sheet tree from the top sheet(s) through sheet symbols (device sheets, Repeat channels and counts), each sheet's ports and its symbols' sheet entries with I/O types and harnesses, the Net Identifier Scope (with what Automatic resolves to) and how nets cross sheets and get their names, the net each port and entry joins when a netlist is loaded, and issues: missing child sheets, entries without ports and ports without entries, I/O mismatches, top-sheet ports, duplicates and cycles.

tools.name: get_project_options
tools.description: Offline Project Options: Net Identifier Scope and net naming, diff-pair suffixes, class generation, multi-channel naming, ERC report levels, the Connection Matrix, Comparator matching and the output path, with an audit of ERC checks switched off or downgraded from Altium's default, relaxed Connection Matrix cells (driver conflicts, unconnected inputs) and No ERC directives on power nets or nets with several pins.

tools.name: check_project_integrity
tools.description: Offline project integrity check for problems that silently break compile, sync or saving: schematics with legacy extensions (.S01/.S02, Update PCB removes their parts), documents missing on disk, a leftover .Annotation file making compiled designators differ from the editor, parts outside the sheet, compile masks hiding parts from the PCB, stale variant entries, hidden, non-ASCII or edge-space characters in net names, designators and parameters (Constraint Manager save failures), bad bus ranges, ActiveBOM-reserved 'Manufacturer N' parameters and multi-channel designator formats that break bus names, each with severity, examples, an Altium fix and its knowledge-base source.

tools.name: get_output_jobs
tools.description: Offline Output Job (.OutJob) review: each OutJob's containers (PDF, folder structure, video, print job) with their path and naming, and its outputs by category with container links and order, data source and variant; coverage of fabrication data, NC drill, pick-and-place, assembly drawings, BOM and ERC/DRC validation; gap and pre-flight findings (BOM and pick-and-place on different variants, wrong data source, ERC validation levels differing from Project Options, output paths on another drive or near the 260-character limit, Gerber vs ODB++ or drill origins, overlays missing from the stack, cutouts without a mechanical layer, Draftsman variants) with severity, an Altium fix and its knowledge-base source; and generated outputs older than the design.

tools.name: check_fab_drawing
tools.description: Offline check of the project's Draftsman fabrication and assembly drawings: each drawing classified from its content, a checklist read from its notes, text, tables and parameters (IPC class, laminate, Tg, UL 94 flammability, surface finish, mask and silkscreen colours, thickness and tolerance, copper weights, impedance, drill table, registration and tolerances, electrical test, rigid-flex items; IPC-A-610 class, BOM table and views for assembly), each item found with its line quoted and located or missing with a suggested note line, and cross-checks against the design: thickness and layer count vs the layer stack, materials, copper weights, impedance notes and table vs the Layer Stack Manager profiles, drill table vs the board's holes, layer stack legend vs the stack, the BOM table's variant vs the OutJob and its parts vs the BOM (with a netlist), the source board and a board saved after the drawing's last update, and contradicting notes.

tools.name: check_release_readiness
tools.description: One offline 'is this ready for review or fab?' report modelled on Altium's Project Releaser: a fixed table of gates, each pass, fail, warn, not_verified or not_applicable with a blocking flag, one line of evidence and the tool to call for details: Batch DRC report clean and newer than the board, ERC (never verifiable offline), netlist newer than the sheets, schematic and PCB in sync, no unrouted nets, polygons repoured, board outline, fiducials, mounting holes, Not Fitted parts left out of the assembly outputs, OutJob complete for every variant and outputs newer than the design, Draftsman fab notes vs the stackup, title-block revision and date, project integrity, the Altium 365 copy committed and up to date, silkscreen DRC, test access on ICT guidance (advisory); footprints vs libraries, lifecycle and compliance, teardrops, via stitching and the team template are reported as not verified. One failed blocking gate fails the release; a missing data source is not verified, never passed.

tools.name: get_design_image
tools.description: Show a picture placed on a schematic sheet or in a Draftsman drawing (e.g. a pasted datasheet excerpt or block diagram) as an image Claude can look at.

tools.name: list_variants
tools.description: List all project variants and their DNP (Do Not Populate) component lists. Returns variant names and which components are excluded in each.

tools.name: set_active_variant
tools.description: Switch the active variant by name. DNP annotations update immediately and all subsequent tool calls reflect the new variant's populated/excluded components.

tools.name: schematic_review
tools.description: Start a structured 3-phase schematic review: power integrity, signal integrity, and BOM/variant sanity. Automatically triggered when the user asks Claude to review the schematic.

tools.name: brainstorm_circuits
tools.description: Start a structured 5-phase circuit brainstorming session: requirements, topology options, component selection, tradeoffs, and next steps. Automatically triggered when the user asks Claude to brainstorm a circuit.

tools.name: package_for_xfn
tools.description: Export the current schematic project to a portable SQLite .db snapshot that cross-functional team members (firmware, mechanical, test, reliability) can query with pcb-copilot. Only call when the user explicitly asks to package or export the project for sharing.

tools.name: get_board_info
tools.description: Return the saved PCB document's board extents, coordinate origin, copper stackup, object counts, parser warnings, and PCB/netlist timestamps. Call this first for layout questions and warn when PCB and schematic freshness differ.

tools.name: get_net_pcb
tools.description: Return physical routing for an exact PCB net, including per-layer length and width, vias, pad endpoints, polygon outlines, bounding box, and active-variant DNP annotations. A regex may be used to discover multiple net names.

tools.name: get_net_neighbors
tools.description: Find same-layer copper within a distance of a PCB net and nets overlapping its route on adjacent copper layers. Results are geometric facts, not a crosstalk severity judgment; polygon overlap uses saved nominal outlines.

tools.name: query_pcb_region
tools.description: Return nearby PCB nets, components, and saved nominal polygon outlines around a coordinate, optionally on one copper layer. Repour polygons and save before relying on polygon results.

tools.name: get_component_placement
tools.description: Return one or more physical PCB instances for a reference designator, including coordinates, side, rotation, bounds, pad nets, nearby components, channel mapping, and active-variant DNP annotations.

tools.name: get_design_rules
tools.description: List the PCB design rules saved in the PcbDoc by kind, priority and scope, or show a kind or rule with its values: widths, gaps, clearance matrix, per-layer values, and stale scope references.

tools.name: get_rules_for_net
tools.description: Resolve which design rules apply to a net or differential pair, the way Altium does by priority: the effective rule per kind with values, conditional overrides, and clearance candidates.

tools.name: get_classes
tools.description: List the PCB's net, component, differential-pair, pad and xSignal classes, or show one class's members with unresolved members and DNP flags.

tools.name: list_diff_pairs
tools.description: List differential pairs with their nets, classes, length per leg (pad-to-pad path plus via barrels) and skew, and the routing rule that applies to each pair.

tools.name: check_rule_compliance
tools.description: Check saved copper against the design rules per object: track widths per layer (diff-pair nets against their routing rule), via diameter and hole, via hole size and annular ring, routing layers and Length windows; optional approximate clearance spot-check. Groups violations and says whether the board's own batch DRC checks each kind.

tools.name: check_lengths
tools.description: Evaluate Length and MatchedLengths rules like Altium: length windows, matched-length groups of xSignals, pairs or nets against the longest member or target, and within-pair skew, measured as pad-to-pad copper path plus via barrels.

tools.name: get_signal_length
tools.description: Measure one net, differential pair, xSignal or pin-to-pin path on the saved copper, including via barrels, with per-layer lengths and unrouted gaps.

tools.name: check_diff_pairs
tools.description: Check differential-pair consistency: undeclared P/N pairs, polarity swaps at component pins (with interface hints), series parts and AC coupling symmetry, and in-pair skew against within-pair rules.

tools.name: check_sch_pcb_sync
tools.description: Offline schematic-vs-PCB sync check, like Altium's Show Differences: parts missing from or extra on the PCB, designator, footprint and comment differences, pads on the wrong net, renamed and one-sided nets, and schematic pins whose footprint has no pad (Update PCB's 'Unknown Pin').

tools.name: diff_design
tools.description: ECO-style changelog between two states of the project: two revisions of its Git clone (read-only, offline) or two folders. Components added, removed, re-designated, revalued, footprint and parameter changes, variant and per-variant BOM line changes, PCB nets added, removed, renamed, merged or split and pins moved, parts moved, rotated or flipped, rule, class, diff-pair and stackup changes, per-net routed length and via deltas, with ICT-fixture warnings for nets that kept their name and designators reused by another part.

tools.name: check_decoupling
tools.description: Offline decoupling coverage: rails with no capacitor to ground, only Not Fitted ones, or fed through a ferrite without their own, and (with the PcbDoc) capacitors far from IC power pads or on the other side without a via.

tools.name: check_pull_resistors
tools.description: Offline pull-up and pull-down audit: reset, enable, boot and strap nets, open-drain and I2C lines, MOSFET gates driven from an IC and comparator outputs with no pull, only Not Fitted pulls, both up and down or parallel pull-ups, and I2C pull-up sizing per bus (effective resistance, Rmin, Rmax and a verdict, NXP UM10204). Heuristic: from net and pin names and pin electrical types.

tools.name: check_interfaces
tools.description: Offline connector and interface protection audit: per connector its exposure (external, internal or unknown, with the basis) and a per-pin table (signal, ground, power, shield or unconnected; ESD/TVS on the path and on which side of a series part, series resistors, ferrites, chokes and capacitors, capacitors to ground, pulls, the first IC pin reached), with findings for exposed pins without ESD, shields tied through an RC network or floating, ground pins reaching ground only through a part, sparse ground pins, low-speed off-board lines with no series footprint and, with the PcbDoc, a TVS nearer the IC than the connector or far from it. Heuristic: parts are recognised by prefix and text.

tools.name: get_firmware_pin_map
tools.description: Offline firmware pin map of a processor (MCU, SoC, FPGA or radio module, ranked by GPIO-named pins, IO pins and processor words): per pin its port and bit, net, the parts it reaches through series parts, pull and a likely function with its basis, as JSON, CSV, a C header or a Zephyr-style devicetree fragment, with findings for UART TX meeting TX, debug or programming pins reaching no header or test pad, boot and strap default levels, external flash or EEPROM access, unused pins, shared nets and pins that change between variants. Heuristic: from pin and net names and pin types.

tools.name: run_erc
tools.description: Offline approximation of Altium's ERC from the saved sheets: violations named, grouped and worded as Altium does (Nets with only one pin, Nets with multiple names, Duplicate Nets, Global Power-Object scope changes, floating net labels and power objects, unconnected wires, ports and sheet entries not linked, ports with no matching ports, missing child sheets, duplicate ports, entries, pins, designators, sheet numbers and sheet names, Un-Designated parts, unused or duplicate sub-parts, Connection Matrix conflicts, unconnected and floating input pins, nets with no driving source, empty net parameters, floating directives, differential pairs missing a partner, off-grid and off-sheet objects, listed one row per sheet with a count) with level, sheet, object, location and a suggested fix, judged by the project's Error Reporting levels and Connection Matrix and honouring No ERC markers and compile masks; advisories for near-duplicate rail names, names differing only in case, near-miss wire ends and a ground-net inventory; a single-pin-net report.

tools.name: check_pcb_health
tools.description: Altium's PCB Health Check Monitor offline: shelved or modified polygons, duplicate designators, zero-area polygons and regions, self-intersecting regions, micro-segments, slot holes, xSignals, 360-degree and off-board components, reference points outside the component, compared with the last DRC report's health section.

tools.name: check_dfm
tools.description: Design-for-manufacture and assembly check of the saved PcbDoc against a fabricator's capability limits (Altimade's published limits built in, a fab_profile.json in the project folder, or limits passed in): trace width, copper spacing, hole walls to copper, hole sizes, annular rings, aspect ratios, hole to hole, copper and holes to the board edge, layer count, copper weight, board size, drill count, board rules looser than the profile, and for the active variant placements and unique parts, parts on both sides, part spacing, parts near the edge, fiducials, tombstoning of small passives, fine pitch and the pick-and-place data (centroids as Altium writes them, parts without pads, the board origin), with each check's status and severity, the board's own minimums and the drill table.

tools.name: check_vias
tools.description: Via inventory and drill review: via types by span, hole and pad with counts per type and net class, aspect ratio, annular ring, via-in-pad, tenting, drill pairs, and back drilling with the via stubs it leaves.

tools.name: check_testpoints
tools.description: Test access (DFT) review of the saved PcbDoc for in-circuit test (bed of nails) or flying probe: probe sites (pads and vias marked as Fabrication Testpoints, TP parts) per side, the share of nets with a site and the probe side, the Testpoint Usage and Testpoint rules resolved per net and site, nets a rule or a critical-net list needs without access, rails and ground probe counts, site size, centre spacing, board-edge clearance, sites under component bodies or near tall parts, tented testpoint vias and tooling holes, against an ict or flying_probe profile of guidance values that take the test house's numbers.

tools.name: check_connectivity
tools.description: Offline copper connectivity, like Altium's Un-Routed Net and Net Antennae rules: per net, whether the saved copper (tracks, vias, pads, poured copper, regions, fills, internal planes) joins all its pads, routing progress, each missing connection with its nearest pads and gap, floating copper and net antennae, beside Altium's last DRC report.

tools.name: get_drc_report
tools.description: Read Altium's last Batch DRC report (HTML or .drc): violations grouped by rule, component or net and linked to the board, PCB health issues and waivers, with an assessment of whether to trust it (stopped at the violation limit, rule kinds not checked, older than the board).

tools.name: get_bom
tools.description: Bill of materials per variant from the compiled parts: lines with quantity, designators, Comment, footprint, manufacturer and MPN (from part parameters), without Not Fitted and no-BOM parts; variant comparison and CSV.

tools.name: check_bom
tools.description: Offline BOM hygiene checks: duplicate designators, unresolved special strings, DNP markers on fitted parts, missing footprints, inconsistent or missing MPNs and manufacturers, placeholder descriptions, stale variant entries and consolidation candidates.

tools.name: get_assembly_guide
tools.description: Assembly sequence for a prototype build of a variant from the saved PcbDoc: the SMD of both sides first (the side with shorter parts first, said why), then through-hole parts, short to tall on each side, in steps per BOM line (by footprint and Comment without a netlist) with quantity, Comment, footprint, MPN, height and per part the designator, Center-X/Y and Ref-X/Y, rotation and a pin-1 or polarity hint; Not Fitted parts, fiducials and parts nobody places left out and listed. A Markdown checklist with Done and Skipped columns, or CSV.

tools.name: constraints_review
tools.description: Start a structured 4-phase review of the PCB's high-speed constraints: identifies interfaces from parts and pins, takes targets from each chip's layout guide, checks pairs, classes, impedance-driven rules, matched-length groups, clearances, reference layers and stale rules, then spot-checks the saved copper. Checks saved rules and copper; quotes Altium's last DRC report only with its assessment. Automatically triggered when the user asks Claude to check the board's high-speed constraints.

tools.name: pcb_manufacturing_review
tools.description: Start a structured manufacturing-readiness review: fabrication against your fab's limits, then assembly, ending in a go/no-go with what was not checked. Asks which fabricator first and never presents Altimade's limits as another fab's.

tools.name: release_review
tools.description: Start a release go/no-go review: runs check_release_readiness, drills into each failing gate with its source tool, and ends in a go/no-go listing the blocking items, what was not verified (never reported as passed) and the warnings.

tools.name: project_tour
tools.description: Start a guided 5-phase tour of the loaded project for a newcomer, in the order Altium teaches a design: project and sheet hierarchy, each schematic block and the power rails, PCB stackup, placement and key nets, outputs and manufacturing state, then variants and design notes. Ends in a Markdown project primer with a fixed outline that Claude saves only where you agree. Adapts to netlist-free loads and projects without a PcbDoc.
